rationale: Promising and operationally feasible but key empirical gaps remain: no blinded split‑lot multi‑site data with per‑sample spike‑in validation, no stability/cold‑chain/shipment qualification of blinded aliquots, and no downstream in vivo bridging (e.g., NHP) linking the analytic fingerprint to recoverability/function. These evidentiary deficits must be addressed before the qualitative fingerprint can serve as a defensible comparability gate.
